name: Layered (N-Tier) Architecture
catalog_source: Richards & Ford (2020), Ch. 10; Bass et al. (2021), Ch. 13
forces_resolved: Clear separation of concerns across presentation, business, and data
Ease of testing and debugging within layers
forces_unresolved: Sinkhole anti-pattern (requests passing through layers with no logic)
applicability_conditions: Small to medium applications with predictable workloads
Development teams requiring straightforward standard structure
Budget constraints favoring minimal infrastructure overhead
anti_requisites: Independent micro-deployment required across business domains
Sub-millisecond latency budgets requiring direct memory sharing
